title: Real-Time Visualization of Pimoroni Enviro Sensor Data from Prometheus
text: Getting Started Enviro PlusEnviro Plus Python GitHub Repository order create server need : 1. Install Pimoroni drivers Pi 2. Install enviroplus_exporter Pi; exports readings metric names app reads (temperature, humidity, pressure, lux, proximity, NH3, reducing, oxidising, PM1, PM25, PM10). Enviro (Enviro+), start --enviro=true, gas particulate sensors 3. Deploy Prometheus server Pi scrapes exporter 4. deploy server use url argument prometheus_url (see )

title: Real-Time Visualization of Pimoroni Enviro Sensor Data from Prometheus
text: live app runs Posit Connect Cloud, deploys GitHub repository using manifest.json. app.R starts app two servers ; change . also sets analytics = TRUE, adds cookie banner sedzinfo.github.io sites , visitor accepts, Google Analytics; pimoroni() leaves unless asked, running app sends nothing. Whenever add remove files change packages app uses, regenerate manifest.json package folder rsconnect::writeManifest(appDir = ".", appPrimaryDoc = "app.R") (command commented bottom app.R) push changes. .rscignore keeps manifest files app needs.
